subject: English Language

questions.prompt: Jamila ___ to school every day. (A go, B goes, C went)
steps: Jamila takes goes for a present habit.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The boys ___ football every Sunday. (A play, B plays, C playing)
steps: A plural subject takes play.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Naomi is ___ a letter now. (A writing, B writes, C write)
steps: Is writing forms present continuous.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Juma and Sara are ___ for the king now. (A dance, B dancing, C danced)
steps: Are takes an ing verb for the ongoing action.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: He ___ late yesterday. (A arrive, B arriving, C arrived)
steps: Yesterday requires past tense.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Where is ___ ball? (A you, B your, C yours)
steps: Use a possessive determiner before ball.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: An elephant is a ___ animal. (A small, B big, C tall)
steps: Big describes its large overall size.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: B. Big is the intended description; tall can also describe an elephant.

questions.prompt: The giraffe is the ___ animal. (A smaller, B tallest, C tall)
steps: Use the superlative after the to express greatest height.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: All Standard Five pupils ___ doing the examination today. (A will, B are, C were)
steps: Are doing describes an activity happening now; were would describe an earlier activity today.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The lion is ___ than the zebra. (A tall, B bigger, C shorter)
steps: Than takes a comparative. Actual size depends on the animals and whether height, length or mass is compared.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: C. Shorter is the supplied scheme's intended answer; B. bigger is also a grammatically valid comparison.

questions.prompt: The red plate is ___. Bank: some, jumped, teaches, mine, taller, you, found.
steps: Mine is a possessive pronoun standing without a following noun.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The monkey is ___ than the hen.
steps: Than requires taller from the bank.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: A teacher ___ children to sing.
steps: A teacher is singular and takes teaches.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: May I have ___ water please?
steps: Some requests an unspecified quantity.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The monkeys ___ from one tree to another.
steps: Jumped is the supplied action verb in past tense.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write 1000 in words.
steps: 1000 is one group of a thousand.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write 2,000,000 in words.
steps: The number has two groups of one million.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write 36 in words.
steps: 36 is thirty plus six.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write 49 in words.
steps: 49 is forty plus nine.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Complete short, ___, shortest.
steps: Add er for the comparative.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Complete ___, longer, longest.
steps: Remove er to recover the positive adjective.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Complete large, larger, ___.
steps: Add st to large for the superlative.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Complete expensive, more expensive, ___.
steps: Use most with the longer adjective.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write the opposite of top.
steps: Bottom is the lowest part, opposite top.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write the opposite of small.
steps: Big contrasts with small in size.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Rajabu is in Standard ___. (A two, B three, C five)
steps: The passage directly states his class.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Mariam and Asha are in Standard ___. (A three, B four, C one)
steps: The passage states both sisters' class.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Who speaks English and Kiswahili well? (A Mariam, B Asha, C Rajabu)
steps: The passage identifies Rajabu as speaking both languages well.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Where is Mawenzi Primary School? (A Dodoma, B Kigoma, C Arusha)
steps: The passage gives this location.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Who is in Standard One? (A Yusufu, B Rashidi, C Asha)
steps: The option spelling differs slightly from the passage but refers to the brother.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write the plural of mango.
steps: Both accepted plural spellings add an ending to mango.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write the plural of flamingo.
steps: A plural ending is required; the supplied scheme's unchanged flamingo is incorrect.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Write the plural of girl.
steps: Add s to the regular noun.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

summaries.Language practice: Use sentence meaning, subject agreement and time clues to choose the word or verb form. Apply the specific rule explained for each task and note ambiguous choices.

references.title: Mitihani ya Darasa la Tano | 2010 - 2023 | Masomo yote (Monthly, Midterm, Terminal and Annual Exams) - Msomi Bora

limitations: 10: Comparison is underspecified; supplied shorter and grammatical bigger require different measures.
32: Supplied marking scheme gives an incorrect unchanged singular.
